description: Suspend an organization member: they lose access immediately but stay a member, and reactivate_member gives it back. memberId is the member id from list_members, not the user id. Requires a confirmationToken: call preview_operation with tool "suspend_member" and these arguments first, show the returned plan to the user, and call this tool only after the user explicitly agrees. Needs the organization:manage permission and the owner role.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name: suspend_member
title: Suspend a member
